summary: Frontend-only iteration. All 7 requested features verified end-to-end against https://kidney-safe-swap.preview.emergentagent.com at mobile viewport 375x667. (A) First-run disclaimer: fresh TEST_ user goes login -> /disclaimer (disclaimer-title + disclaimer-accept) -> /onboarding after accept. Demo user (localStorage cleared) also gated. localStorage key renal.disclaimer.<userId>="accepted" set correctly; subsequent reloads keep the user on /(app) without re-showing disclaimer. (B) Search error state: window.fetch stubbed to reject -> search-error container and search-retry both appear; restoring fetch and clicking search-retry recovers the list. (C) Meal-log error state: same treatment -> meal-log-error + meal-log-retry render, retry recovers. (D) Tier filter chips: tier-filter-green/yellow/red all tappable. Tapping RED alone returns exactly 12 RED foods (Palak Paneer, Besan Chilla, Rajma, Chole, Aloo Sabzi, Methi Saag, Banana (Full), Orange, Coconut Water, Achar, Papad, Samosa) — matches spec 1:1. RED+YELLOW multi-select returns 23 (RED + YELLOW badges only). Deselecting a chip clears its filter; deselecting all restores 25 foods. (E) Ask-AI persistence: clear-chat-button hidden when empty; sending 'Is lauki safe?' produced a proper AI answer bubble; renal.chat.<userId> written to AsyncStorage; page reload restores both messages verbatim. clear-chat-button empties messages and reload-post-clear keeps chat empty. Different registered user shows empty chat (per-user keying confirmed). (F) Meal-log date nav: prev-day + next-day + meal-log-date all present; label shows 'Today' on today and 'Wed Jul 01 2026' after tapping prev; next-day has disabled=true on today (aria-disabled = true and no-op) and is enabled on non-today dates. Prev-day showed empty list for yesterday, next-day returned to today with all 3 logged meals visible. (G) LogBox: no LogBox.ignoreAllLogs in app/_layout.tsx (verified). App loads cleanly. Only console warning is 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' emitted by react-navigation/react-native-web internals (upstream, acceptable per review request). No new runtime errors, no red screen, no crashes.
action_items: (Nit, non-blocking) In ask-ai.tsx clearChat: setMessages([]) triggers the persist useEffect which writes "[]" to storage right after storage.removeItem(...). Net functional behaviour is identical (chat is empty on reload), but the AsyncStorage key stays present with value "[]" instead of being fully removed. If you want strict key-removal semantics, either (a) skip the persist effect when messages.length===0 AND restored is true just after clear (add a flag), or (b) do the removeItem AFTER the next tick / inside a useEffect gated by messages.length. Purely cosmetic — reload-empty behaviour already meets the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx: correct 3-state gating (loading -> null spinner -> redirect). disclaimerAccepted starts null and stays null until AsyncStorage resolves, preventing the flash-of-onboarding bug that could occur if you defaulted to false.
disclaimer.tsx uses expo-router useLocalSearchParams to switch between accept and readonly modes with distinct testIDs (disclaimer-accept vs disclaimer-close) — clean.
(app)/index.tsx tier filter debounce: useEffect fires load with a 250ms setTimeout on [query, selectedTiers, load] — good UX and single request per burst.
meal-log.tsx date helpers (isoDate/shiftDate/prettyDate) do local-time math via Date constructor — no timezone drift observed for adjacent-day navigation.
ask-ai.tsx guards persistence with a `restored` flag so the initial empty [] doesn't overwrite a real saved chat before restore completes — good.
_layout.tsx: LogBox import fully removed. Only remaining pointerEvents warning traces to react-navigation internals (verified via console traces during nav).
